spec.title: Inter-site topology
spec.description: Directional ASIC throughput; colors show utilization against circuit capacity. Parallel circuits remain separate. Amber question nodes represent unpaired interfaces, not confirmed far-end connections. Hover links for port/state details and selected-range traffic in TB. Click a node for the detailed link dashboard. Timeline replays throughput and state; period TB totals refer to the whole selected range.
